shroud_profile.rear_transition: Rear opening radius to z=0; straight segment to 30.25 + radial_clearance at z=4.5.
shroud_profile.front_transition: 20.3 + radial_clearance at z=21; straight segment to inlet radius at chamber_height.
shroud_profile.method: Signed meridional distance to 64 ellipse chords plus explicit transition segments; outer wall is the distance offset.
shroud_profile.clearance_note: Assumed radial clearance; neither a normal running clearance nor a qualified interface. Final Smoothen moves surfaces.

study.junction_limitation: The 360-degree sweep endpoints share one center; the large end overlaps the small start. Nominal pi*a^2 is not the effective section near the junction or diffuser union.
study.inspiration: QUASAR Phy-CC area-growth principle only; no third-party code copied. Its moving center and clamped sqrt(t) law are not reproduced.

baseline.station_rule: All closed bands touching each station; take their minimum lower bound.

candidate.station_rule: All closed bands touching each station; take their minimum lower bound.

method: Each closed Z band uses every overlapping triangle in full. Rotor maximum is the largest vertex radius; housing minimum is distance to the entire XY-projected triangle, including its interior. No angular sampling.
interpretation: A positive bound establishes radial separation of these triangulated meshes for every rotation about Z. An indeterminate bound is not collision evidence. These are bandwise radial bounds, not minimum Euclidean, thermal or manufactured clearances.
